title: Gabe Evans
intro:
Gabe Evans (Republican Party) is a member of the U.S. House, representing Colorado's 8th Congressional District. He assumed office on January 3, 2025. His current term ends on January 3, 2027.
Evans (Republican Party) is running for re-election to the U.S. House to represent Colorado's 8th Congressional District. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. He advanced from the Republican primary on June 30, 2026.
Evans completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
